verdict.rationale: WooCommerce docs confirm product variations/attributes (color/size style), variable products, and extension marketplace for custom needs, but evidence doesn't show native custom fields/metafields UI beyond attributes, nor a flexible schema builder—custom fields typically require plugins/extensions rather than a built-in flexible metafield system. missing for 10: explicit native custom fields/metafields support, evidence of flexible attribute schema beyond variations, independent hands-on confirmation of catalog modeling flexibility.
